answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 37023 Country: India Title: It is learnt that Bohra follow female circumcision and say that it is in the hadith Question: It is learnt that Bohra follow female circumcision and say that it is in the hadith. Please let me know if the same is correct and what opinion does the Quran and hadith have about this ritual. Is it correct to follow the same? Answer ID: 37023 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 477/235/L=1433) It is right for women to go through circumcision. However, it is not sunnah for women like men. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
